prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: full-bleed cinematic scene for an intimate Chinese garden story, portrait 2:3.
Visual language: luminous, jewel-bright late-afternoon cinema, candid still from a sumptuous period film rather than a costume catalogue. Extremely tactile golden sunlight against deep clean petrol-blue woodland shadows. Warm sunlight STRIKES patches of cheeks, noses, fingers, loose hair and translucent ivory sleeves; the skin is NOT uniformly lit by a studio softbox. Preserve a sculptural transition from bright warm highlights into cool shadows; bold chiaroscuro, radiant rather than dim, neither muddy sepia nor flat HDR. Clear bright sunlit color, glowing translucent petals, creamy foreground flower bokeh, soft lens halation on the hottest highlights, crisp eyes, fine skin texture. Close 50mm cinematography, f/1.8, shallow depth, natural movement caught between poses. The light source is low and behind the women to camera-right. No oversized sunburst star, no fake beams crossing faces.
Wardrobe: airy layered historical-inspired hanfu with luminous IVORY ramie-and-silk gauze outer sleeves over coloured silk skirts and collars; delicate woven flower motifs, sunlight visibly transmits through folds. Loose fine hair, small flowers tucked near the ears. Avoid rough thick brown linen, heavy jackets, theatrical armour, modern accessories. Distinct recurring friends: A-tang with a soft round face, smiling eyes, a small coral flower at her half-up bun and coral-pink inner skirt; Qing-he with an oval face, gently arched brows, a jade ribbon in a loose low bun, celadon-green skirt; Wen-xi with a longer oval face, almond eyes, a blue ribbon in long half-up hair, sky-blue skirt and deep azure collar. All three are adult East Asian women in their twenties, fully dressed, joyful and unposed, each clearly different.
Composition: PORTRAIT 2:3 vertical photograph for a phone screen. All three women's complete faces fit safely inside the central 80 percent of the width, arranged in a close triangular grouping in the upper half, with faces centered between 22 and 43 percent from the top. Keep 10 percent margin above hair and beside each head. No cut-off faces or cropped heads. Show the shared action at center. Fill the lower third with soft luminous flowers, flowing ivory gauze and painterly lens bokeh. This is a real vertical composition, not a cropped wide photograph, not three people lined up in a horizontal row. No lettering, no blackening for text. Natural believable hands and correct anatomy.
Constraints: original characters, no text, letters, captions, subtitles, calligraphy, logos, watermark, black bars, borders, collage, panels, poster, interface, fantasy effects, plastic skin or excessive airbrushing. Edge-to-edge image.

Scene: share green plums under an orchard tree, an intimate close shot. The three friends lean together beneath hanging green fruit and small branches. A-tang holds a single small green plum in an open palm; Wen-xi reaches with one natural hand to choose it and smiles; Qing-he peers between them. Sideways shafts of real low sun pierce leaves, painting bright warm dappled patches over cheeks, knuckles and ivory embroidered gauze, with dramatically deep clean cobalt-blue foliage behind. Luminous orange and green defocused leaves hang close to the lens and frame but do not cover eyes. Their faces and the small plum are clearly readable. Strong intimate light-and-shadow texture reminiscent of a beautiful photographic film still, not an evenly lit group portrait.
